parole.significato: A unit of weight formerly used in the Ottoman period.
parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish بطمان (batman), from Proto-Turkic *batmān, from Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (ptmʾn' /⁠paymān⁠/, “measure, period; moderation; treaty”), compare Persian پیمان (peymân, “pledge; pact; agreement; contract”). Doublet of peyman.

From Ottoman Turkish طرامق (taramak), from Proto-Turkic *tara- (“to comb”), possibly also related to Proto-Turkic *tar- (“to scatter, spread”). See dağılmak. Cognates Cognate with Azerbaijani daramaq, Kazakh тарау (taraw), Kyrgyz тароо (taroo), Uzbek taramoq, Tatar таратырга (taratırğa), Turkmen dar
